title: Oak Ridge visit arranged by Howard Baker

tellings.quote: I went to go up to Oak Ridge and spend some time with them

plain: Harald Malmgren, a former adviser to US presidents, says Senator Howard Baker of Tennessee arranged for him to visit Oak Ridge, the government nuclear research site in Tennessee, sometime in the 1970s or 1980s. Malmgren tells Michels he went up there "and spend some time with them." He tells it as part of his account of having dealt directly with UFO material.
